scene: The quarterly desk audit. The run sets up the team-b desk, enters as the shared desk, reads a team-b page, then enters as the swap desk and reads the shared desk page, then enters again as the shared desk and reads it a second time; the board writes the desk it acted for into every one of those lines. The second half is the ledger, which hands the same grant back twice and then a new one, followed by the tile host, which hands back a fresh grant with every one of twenty replies. The tile host then retires the newest grants and the run checks which still-live grant remains in the next request.
